title: DAQ: Decision-Aligned Post-Training Quantization for Spiking Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.22611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spiking transformers combine attention-based representation learning with sparse spike communication, yet their weights and membrane variables still incur substantial storage and computation overhead. Post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical way to reduce these overheads, but preserving neuronal firing under weight and membrane quantization remains challenging. In this paper, we propose Decision-Aligned Post-Training Quantization (DAQ), a method that calibrates the quantizers to align neuronal firing decisions with those of a floating-point reference. We analyze how errors from these quantizers affect firing at decision boundaries and how they propagate over time steps in recurrent neurons. Based on this analysis, we formulate an objective that encourages quantized membrane variables to remain within the reference firing regions along the quantized model's own state trajectory. translated_title: DAQ：面向脉冲Transformer的决策对齐训练后量化方法
translated_abstract: 脉冲Transformer将基于注意力的表征学习与稀疏的脉冲通信相结合，但其权重和膜变量仍然带来较大的存储与计算开销。训练后量化（PTQ）为降低这些开销提供了一种实用的途径，然而在权重和膜变量量化的情况下保持神经元的放电行为仍具有挑战性。本文提出了决策对齐训练后量化（DAQ），该方法通过校准量化器，使神经元的放电决策与浮点参考模型保持一致。我们分析了这些量化器产生的误差如何影响决策边界处的放电行为，以及这些误差如何在循环神经元中随时间步传播。基于这一分析，我们构建了一个优化目标，鼓励量化后的膜变量沿着量化模型自身的状态轨迹保持在参考放电区域内。在多种脉冲Transformer上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 提出决策对齐训练后量化方法DAQ，通过校准量化器使脉冲Transformer神经元的放电决策与浮点参考模型对齐，从而在权重和膜变量量化的同时有效保持神经元的放电行为。
en_tdlr: DAQ is a decision-aligned post-training quantization method that calibrates quantizers to align neuronal firing decisions with a floating-point reference, preserving spiking behavior in spiking transformers under weight and membrane quantization.
